title: Drop skill_source = "plugin" and restore a repo-local lore skill: the plugin is disabled in this checkout, so no lore skill exists at runtime (DEC-238 a1)
description:
Ruling DEC-238 (a1) from opum-doc, 2026-10-25T06:47:40Z (record: opum-doc PR chore/dec-238-a1), verbatim: "while opum-lore is off in a checkout, workers get the lore skill from a REPO-LOCAL generated SKILL.md. The 2026-10-20 per-checkout setting is left untouched, whatever its reason. A repository returns to skill_source = \"plugin\" only once the plugin is measured enabled in its own checkout. Each plugin-source repository with the plugin off in its checkout drops the skill_source = \"plugin\" line, runs `lore agents`, and confirms --check exits 0, as its own tier-2 decision, scheduled in the plan."

MEASURED in this checkout on 2026-10-25, before acting:
- `git show origin/dev:.lore/config.toml` line 29 sets `skill_source = "plugin"` (under [agents]).
- `.claude/settings.local.json` (gitignored) sets `opum-lore@opum=false`, i.e. the plugin is disabled for this checkout.
- `.claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md` does not exist.
- `lore agents --check` (lore 0.14.1) prints `absent-plugin-sourced .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md` and `plugin-claude disabled opum-lore@opum scope=user`, and exits 0.
Net: the repository names the plugin as its skill source while the plugin is off here, so the lore skill is absent at runtime.

This is a tier-2 decision about this repository own governing files: the edit is the owning session decision, or its user, not an instruction relayed from the orchestrator. It is NOT scheduled yet; start nothing until the plan schedules it. The per-checkout plugin setting in settings.local.json is explicitly untouched by this action.

Context: QCLI-237 (Done) opted this repo into skill_source = "plugin" in 2026-09-05, when the plugin was enabled here. This task reverses that declaration for as long as the plugin stays off in this checkout, and re-establishing it later is a separate measured step.

acceptanceCriteria.text: git show origin/dev:.lore/config.toml no longer sets skill_source = "plugin": the [agents] table omits the key, or the table is removed
lore agents regenerates .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md from the repo-local source, and the file is committed on dev
lore agents --check reports the repo-local lore skill as up-to-date, with no absent-plugin-sourced line, and exits 0
lore check exits 0 on the landing commit
.claude/settings.local.json is unchanged: the per-checkout plugin setting stays exactly as it is, whatever its reason

definitionOfDone.text: The change is tracker and config only: no product source, tests or packaging are touched
The landing PR records the measured evidence and the DEC-238 (a1) citation
A later return to skill_source = "plugin" is only made after the plugin is measured enabled in this checkout
